_design_note: Neutral gate and projection descriptions. No raw spectral gap values or isomorphism scores in candidate texts. PSE tags (diagnostic_outcome, closed_outcome, rejected_outcome, g_gap_fail, g_iso_fail, g_iso_pass, operator_compatible, gate_order_preserved, trace_dep_preserved, replay_dep_preserved, spec_violation, wrong_outcome, empty_iso_list, preflight_only) are the only reliable signal. Name-trap 1: MetatronClosureOutcome::Rejected sounds like the right answer when gate fails, but Rejected is only for pre-flight checks; gate failure produces Diagnostic. Name-trap 2: a projection with high isomorphism_score but operator_path_compatible=false is NOT passed — the 4 boolean criteria determine passed, not the score.

cases.title: G_gap failure — spectral gap degraded after stitching, what is the closure outcome and recovery?

metatron_context.description: MetatronGateReport with G_gap=false. SpectralGapStitchReport.improved_or_preserved=false: the post-stitch spectral gap is smaller than the prior gap (delta_gap < 0). All other gates passed. G_meta = G_nctcs ∧ G_trace ∧ G_replay ∧ G_iso ∧ G_gap ∧ G_eval ∧ G_drift = false. The pipeline is fail-closed: when G_meta=0, no HolisticEigenmodeState may be produced. Only MetatronClosureOutcome::Diagnostic is returned, containing the gate report and supporting data — never the productive closure state.

candidates.text: Closure outcome returned when the MetatronGate fails. Contains the gate report, local monolith projections, isomorphism reports and spectral gap report for post-run analysis. No HolisticEigenmodeState is produced.

Reads the delta_gap field from the SpectralGapStitchReport. Determines whether the gap degraded due to a structural stitching error (wrong stitch candidates) or a metric computation anomaly in the tensor delta.

Re-evaluates the stitch candidate set for the stitching step. Removes candidates whose tensor delta reduces the spectral gap below the prior value, and resubmits the stitching pipeline with the revised candidate set.
Closure outcome returned during pre-flight validation when a required input is absent or malformed before gate evaluation begins, such as a zero trace_head.
candidates._trap: Rejected is returned BEFORE gate evaluation for pre-flight failures (e.g. missing trace). Gate failures produce Diagnostic, not Rejected. G_gap failure occurs during gate evaluation.

candidates.text: Closure outcome returned when G_meta=1 and a content-addressed HolisticEigenmodeState has been successfully produced from the field tensor, MacroControlState and trace.
candidates._trap: Closed is the desired outcome but impossible when G_meta=0. Fail-closed invariant: no HolisticEigenmodeState may be produced when any gate fails.

candidates.text: Produces a HolisticEigenmodeState with validation_status=Diagnostic, bypassing the gate check so that downstream layers receive a closure state object for analysis.
candidates._trap: HolisticEigenmodeState MUST NOT be produced when G_meta=0, regardless of validation_status. The spec does not permit a 'diagnostic HolisticEigenmodeState' — that is the purpose of MetatronDiagnosticReport.

candidates.text: Directly sets improved_or_preserved=true in the SpectralGapStitchReport to force the G_gap check to pass without recomputing the stitch delta.
Lowers the spectral gap preservation requirement in MetatronThresholds to accept the degraded gap value as within tolerance.
Constructs a HolisticEigenmodeState directly from the current resonance field instead of from the persistent field tensor and MacroControlState.
candidates._trap: MetatronOperator is NOT a controller and MUST derive state from persistent tensor and MacroControlState, not from ephemeral resonance. Also violates fail-closed invariant.

candidates.text: Removes G_drift from the gate evaluation to reduce the number of failing conditions that block closure.
candidates._trap: G_drift is not the failing gate — G_gap failed. Skipping G_drift does not affect the outcome.

correct_next_actions: inspect_spectral_gap_delta to diagnose why post-stitch gap < prior gap
repair_stitch candidate set to restore improved_or_preserved=true
rejected_false_paths: Rejected (pre-flight outcome only — gate failures produce Diagnostic)
build_holistic_state_with_Diagnostic_status (spec violation — no HES when gate fails)

cases.title: G_iso audit — which isomorphic projection reports satisfy the operator-compatibility criteria?

metatron_context.g_iso_rule: G_iso passes iff iso_reports is non-empty AND all(r.passed for r in iso_reports). r.passed = operator_path_compatible AND gate_order_preserved AND trace_dependency_preserved AND replay_dependency_preserved
metatron_context.description: Five IsomorphicProjectionReport candidates were submitted for G_iso evaluation. Each report derives its passed field from four boolean criteria: operator_path_compatible (local field operator implements the same operatorik as the global closure path), gate_order_preserved (gate evaluation order matches global path), trace_dependency_preserved, and replay_dependency_preserved. All four must be true for passed=true. An empty submission list also fails G_iso even if all other gates pass. The isomorphism_score field is a computed metric and does not override the passed determination.

events.message: G_iso evaluation: iso_all_passed = !iso_reports.is_empty() && all(r.passed); checking 5 reports
G_iso result: 3 reports passed, 2 failed -> iso_all_passed=false -> G_meta=false

candidates.text: Local monolith projection report for the primary phase operator. The local operator path matches the global closure path schema. Gate evaluation order is consistent with the global path. Trace and replay dependencies are both preserved in the projection.

Local monolith projection report for the secondary resonance carrier. The projection declares operator compatibility with the global path, preserves gate ordering, and carries full trace and replay dependency links.

Local monolith projection report for the horizon carrier module. All four compatibility criteria are satisfied: operator path matches global schema, gate order is preserved, and both trace and replay dependencies are linked.

Local monolith projection report for an auxiliary field operator. Gate evaluation order is preserved and both dependency links are intact. The operator schema diverges from the global closure path operatorik.
candidates._trap: operator_path_compatible=false. The passed field is derived from all four criteria — a single false criterion rejects the report regardless of gate order or dependency preservation.

candidates.text: Local monolith projection report for a spectral stitch module. Operator compatibility and dependency links are declared. The gate evaluation sequence in this projection does not match the ordering of the global closure path.
candidates._trap: gate_order_preserved=false. Gate order mismatch alone is sufficient to set passed=false.

candidates.text: Submits no IsomorphicProjectionReport entries to the gate evaluation. The gate proceeds with an empty list and evaluates the remaining conditions.
candidates._trap: G_iso requires at least one report. An empty list fails G_iso unconditionally: iso_all_passed = !iso_reports.is_empty() && ... — the first condition is false.

candidates.text: Selects reports based on a high isomorphism_score value, treating the score as the primary eligibility criterion for G_iso passage.
candidates._trap: isomorphism_score is a computed metric and does not determine passed. Only the four boolean criteria (operator_path_compatible, gate_order_preserved, trace_dependency_preserved, replay_dependency_preserved) determine passed.

candidates.text: Sets passed=true on all IsomorphicProjectionReport entries regardless of the individual criteria values, to allow G_iso to pass with incompatible projections.
Removes G_iso from the MetatronGate conjunction, allowing the closure to proceed without isomorphic projection validation.
Submits the NctcsConformanceReport hash as a substitute for an IsomorphicProjectionReport, treating NCTCS conformance as equivalent to operator isomorphism.

correct_next_actions: projection_alpha passes G_iso (all four criteria: operator_compatible, gate_order, trace, replay)
projection_beta passes G_iso (all four criteria satisfied)
projection_gamma passes G_iso (all four criteria satisfied)
